findings.description: Critical: the projection request models use Pydantic's default extra-field policy, so undeclared request and projection-key members are silently ignored even though both OpenAPI schemas set additionalProperties=false; invalid projection mutations therefore succeed instead of returning the required 422 Problem.
findings.resolution: Set extra='forbid' on ProjectionKeyRequest, WorkSubmitRequest, and WorkReconcileRequest, and add HTTP tests for unknown top-level and nested projection-key fields.

findings.description: Critical: WorkSubmitRequest declares depends_on as arbitrary strings and converts them to UUID only inside the route, so a non-UUID passes request validation and raises ValueError at runtime instead of producing the OpenAPI-declared 422 RFC 7807 Problem.
findings.resolution: Type depends_on as UUID values (or validate each string in the Pydantic model) and add a malformed dependency HTTP test that asserts status 422 and application/problem+json.

findings.description: Critical: service-layer submit_work policy and guardrail denials return SubmitResult(success=false) without a reason, and the HTTP mapper converts any unrecognized failure to an HTTP 200 {success:false, reason:null}; this violates the contract that HTTP 200 is ProjectionMutationSuccess and policy or validation failures are 4xx Problems, and it can disagree with the principal authorization already performed by the route.
findings.resolution: Preserve a discriminating denial reason from WorkQueueService, map service denials to 403 (and validation or guardrail failures to an appropriate 4xx Problem), and test the route when service-level policy denies after route authorization.
